## Ladon dragon (CR 24)

A hundred heads on a hundred necks rise from the immense body of this hydra-like dragon. Its scales have the color of wood, but the shine and hardness of bronze.  

Its many mouths open deafening you with the madness of multiple arguing voices.  

**XP** 1,228,800  
N Colossal dragon  
**Init** +2; **Senses** all-round vision, dragon senses, true seeing; Perception +50  
**Aura** frightful presence (360 ft., DC 34)  


**Defense**


**AC** 42, touch 0, flat-footed 42 (-2 Dex, +42 natural, -8 size)  
**Hp** 521 (34d12+300); regeneration 10 (epic)  
**Fort** +29, **Ref** +17, **Will** +28  
**DR** 20/epic and magic; **Immune** mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, sonic; **SR** 35  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +43 (4d8+24/19-20 plus vortex of a hundred bites), 2 claws +42 (4d6+16/19-20), tail slap +40 (4d6+24/19-20)  
**Space** 30 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft. (30 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** mayhem choir, poison breath (70 ft. cone, DC 37)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 20th, concentration +27)  


Constant—true seeing  

At will—banshee blast (DC 23), foresight, greater dispel magic, pessimism (DC 22), vision  

1/day—mage’s disjunction, summon (level 9, 1 pleiad or 2-5 hesperides, 100%)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 42, **Dex** 6, **Con** 30, **Int** 24, **Wis** 28, **Cha** 24  
**Base Atk** +34; **CMB** +58; **CMD** 64 (68 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Alertness, Cleave, Cleaving Finish, Critical Focus, Great Cleave, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Cleaving Finish, Improved Critical (bite, claw, tail), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Staggering Critical, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Appraise +44, Bluff +44, Climb +53, Diplomacy +44, Intimidate +44, Knowledge (arcana, history, geography, religion) +44, Linguistics +44, Perception +50, Sense Motive +50, Spellcraft +44  
**Languages** Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Sylvan, plus any 30 others  
**SQ** change shape (Medium constrictor snake or Large tree; beast shape I or tree shape), hydra traits, regenerate head, vision of madness  


**Special Abilities**


**Hydra Traits (Ex)** A ladon can be killed by severing all of its heads or slaying its body. Any attack that is not an attempt to sever a head affects the body, including area attacks or attacks that cause piercing or bludgeoning damage. To sever a head, an opponent must make a sunder attempt with a slashing weapon targeting a head. A head is considered a separate weapon with hardness 0 and 34 hit points. To sever a head, an opponent must inflict enough damage to reduce the head’s hit points to 0 or less. Severing a head deals 34 points of damage to Ladon’s body. Ladon can’t attack with a severed head, but takes no other penalties.  

**Mayhem Choir (Su)** A ladon can talk all at once from many of its heads even while other heads are attacking, giving different bits of information, chattering, or babble with each one. An opponent who tries to make sense of the dragon’s dozens of voices can momentarily lose their sanity. Each round that it uses mayhem choir, all opponents within 40 feet are affected as confusion (DC 34 Will negates). Once a creature has been affected by this ability, it is then immune to it for 24 hours. The saving throw is Charisma-based.  

**Poison Breath (Ex)** A ladon can use its breath weapon every 1d4 rounds through any one of its heads, but will emit it through only one head at a time. Creatures within the cone take 2d6 points of Constitution damage (Fortitude save to half damage). A ladon’s poison breath bypasses any immunity or resistance to poison that a target can have. A creature that succeeds at its saving throw against it’s poison breath is immune to further poison breath attacks for 24 hours. The saving throw is Constitution-based.  

**Regenerate Head (Ex)** When one of a ladon’s heads is destroyed, it regrows in 1d4 rounds. To prevent a new head from growing, at least 5 points of acid or fire damage must be dealt to the stump (a touch attack to hit) before they appear. Acid or fire damage from area attacks can affect stumps and the body simultaneously. A ladon doesn’t die from losing its heads until all are cut off and the stumps seared by acid or fire.  

**Regeneration (Ex)** A ladon’s regeneration applies only to damage inflicted on its body.  

**Vision of Madness (Su)** Some of a ladon’s heads could actually speak valuable advice or the one piece of information that someone was searching for. If a creature doesn’t fall victim of Ladon’s mayhem choir ability, it has a 10% chance to be granted a vision, as per the spell. This chance is cumulative for every subsequent Will save against mayhem choir that the creature succeeded at. The vision will have effect the next time the creature sleeps after the combat against Ladon ends.  

**Vortex of a Hundred Bites (Ex)** Ladon can bite with each one of its hundred heads in a round, but you don’t have to resolve each of these as a separate attack. Instead, Ladon rolls for one bite attack normally and hits every creature in its reach if its attack roll exceeds that creature’s AC. If the attack roll results in a possible critical hit, the critical is applied to one creature of Ladon’s choosing.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** triple
